title: Quick Flaky Japanese Noodle Udon
description: A light and fatty Japanese dish featuring udon noodles, hotsauce, and nuka-pickle, this recipe is jain-friendly and perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the hotsauce, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped nuka-pickle to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked udon noodles to the skillet and toss with the nuka-pickle mixture.
Pour the hotsauce mixture over the noodles and toss to combine.
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and garnish with thinly sliced scallions and toasted sesame seeds.
